question: Where was the first hot air balloon wildlife safari launched in India in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve.**__

__
 
• **In Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve the first hot air balloon wildlife safari launched in India in December 2020.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• India's first air balloon wild safari was launched in Tiger reserve Madhya Pradesh.
 
• **Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve **is located in Umaria district, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is known for its royal population of royal bengal tigers.
 
• It consists of three main zones Tala, Madadhi,Kitauli.​
 
• Tala zone has a rich biodiversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Tiger reserve**
 **Details**
 
 

 Palamu Tiger Reserve
 
 
 
• It is one of the nine tiger reserves in Jharkhand.
 
• It forms a part of **Betla National park **and** Palamau wildlife sanctuary**
 
 
 
 

 Pilibhit Tiger Reserve
 
 
 
• It is located in the Philbhit district of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• It was notified as a tiger reserve in 2014.
 
• It forms a part of the Terai Arc Landscape in the upper Indo-Gangetic along** the Indo-Nepal **border.
 
 
 
 

 Ranthambore Tiger Reserve
 
 
 
• It is located in the Sawai Madhopur district of southeastern Rajasthan.
 
• It is bounded to the north by **Banas** river and south by **Chambal** river.
